summary: 49-year-old Boulder man fell climbing at the Shark Fin feature of The Crags, breaking his leg; RMNP medics treated on scene; Blackhawk hoist helicopter hoisted subject to Estes Park Fairgrounds; ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center.
location: The Crags, base of Shark Fin, near Estes Park
notes: Source: Larimer County SAR Facebook page and Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page (mutual aid). Agencies: LCSAR, RMNP rescuers, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Air Force Rescue Coordination Center, MRA (mutual aid).
